s: Which of the following is a learning disability in children?
src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
x: Dyslexia, a difficulty in reading despite normal intelligence, is the standard example of a learning disability in children.

s: Which of the following is related to article 370 of the Indian Constitution?
src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I, Assistant Public Relation,
x: Article 370 related to the special status of Jammu and Kashmir (abrogated in August 2019).

s: Which of the following pairs given below is incorrectly matched? (Year - India - Pak Conflict)
src: APPSC Junior Assistant cum Computer Assistant in ANGRAU Gene
x: The first India-Pakistan war over Kashmir was 1947-48, not 1965, so '1965 – First war over Kashmir' is the wrong pair.

s: Which of the following mountain passes forms the "Tri-Junction" of India, China and Myanmar?
src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer General S
x: Diphu Pass in Arunachal Pradesh lies at the India–China–Myanmar tri-junction.

s: Consider the following pairs (Indian Border - Country). Which of the pairs is incorrectly matched?
src: APPSC Junior Assistant cum Computer Assistant in ANGRAU Gene
x: Dawki (Meghalaya)–Tamabil (Sylhet) is an India–Bangladesh border crossing, so pairing it with China is the incorrect match.

s:
Which of the following is/are correct about East Asia Summit?

a. 13th East Asia Summit held in Singapore.

b. It is an ASEAN-Centered Forum.

c. It can only be chaired by an ASEAN Member.

d. East Asia Summit comprises the ten member states of the ASEAN.
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
x: a, b and c are correct: 13th EAS in Singapore (2018), ASEAN-centred, chaired only by an ASEAN member. d is wrong – the EAS has 18 members, not just the ten ASEAN states; so 'all of the above' is wrong.

s: The impact of Bharatiya Janata Party emerging as a strong political force is dated to:
src: APPSC Group-I Prelims 2010 (25-10-2010)
x: Garbled: no event in the 'rise of the BJP' is dated to these days; the options belong to a different question – 18 Dec 2006 is when the US Hyde Act (India-US civil nuclear cooperation) was signed. No key can be given for this stem.

s:
Which of the following statements is/are correct about United Nations?

a. "United Nations" name was devised by Franklin D. Roosevelt.

b. All the member states meet once after every two years in General Assembly Hall, New York.

c. It is the General Assembly which elects all the 54 members for Economic and Social Council.

d. Judges of the International Court of Justice are elected for 8 years.
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
x: a and c are correct: Roosevelt devised the name 'United Nations' and the GA elects all 54 ECOSOC members; the GA meets every year (not every two years) and ICJ judges serve nine years (not eight).

s: Which of the following is not the part of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity under UNESCO?
src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
x: India's entries on UNESCO's Representative List include Vedic chanting, Ramlila, Kutiyattam, Ramman and others, but not the Mahabharata.

s: Which of the following is not the member of SAARC?
src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I Common Paper General Studies
x: Myanmar is not a SAARC member (only an observer); it is in ASEAN and BIMSTEC.

s: Which one of the following statements is not correct in respect of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)?
o: Its Headquarters is located in Kathmandu.
China is the only country with an Observer status in SAARC.
The First SAARC Summit was held in Dhaka.
The First SAARC Summit was held in Dhaka.
src: CDS 2017
x: SAARC has nine observers (EU, Australia, China, Iran, Japan, Korea, Mauritius, Myanmar, USA), so 'China is the only observer' is wrong; Kathmandu HQ and the 1st Summit at Dhaka are correct.

s:
a. BIMSTEC is headquartered at Dhaka.
b. India and Pakistan are members of BIMSTEC.
Which of the given statements is/are correct?
src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer Screening Test General Stu
x: BIMSTEC's Secretariat is in Dhaka (statement a correct); Pakistan is not a BIMSTEC member (statement b wrong).

s:
Which of the following statements is/are correct about Pravasi Bhartiya Diwas?

1. It is celebrated on 9th January of every year.

2. It was started by the Ex-Prime Minister of India Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

3. It is celebrated because Mahatma Gandhi returned to India from South Africa on 9th January, 1915.

4. First Pravasi Bhartiya Diwas took place in 2003.
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: All four are correct: PBD falls on 9 January, the day Gandhi returned from South Africa in 1915; it was instituted by the Vajpayee government, and the first PBD was held on 9 January 2003.

s:
Consider the following statements with respect to 'NCC Flag':

a. NCC Flag Contains NCC Crest in gold in the middle, with the letters "NCC" encircled by a wreath of seventeen lotus with a background in Red, Blue and Light blue.

b. Red depicts the Navy, Deep Blue depicts the Army and Light Blue depicts the Air Force.

c. The seventeen lotuses represent the 17 State Directorates. "Unity of Discipline" (Ekta aur Anushasan) is written at the bottom of the NCC Flag.
Which of the above statements are correct?
src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
x: Statement b is wrong: in the NCC flag red stands for the Army, deep blue for the Navy and light blue for the Air Force. The crest with 17 lotuses (17 State Directorates) and the motto 'Unity and Discipline' (Ekta aur Anushasan) are as stated.

s: When did the new anti-terror laws come into force after Presidential assent?
src: APPSC AEs 2009
x: The NIA Act, 2008 and the UAPA (Amendment) Act, 2008, passed after 26/11, received Presidential assent on 31 December 2008 (there is no 31 November).

s:
Arrange the following programmes in order of their introduction in India:

a. Adult Education Programme

b. National Adult Education Programme

c. National Extension Service

d. Total Literacy Campaign
src: APPSC Assistant B.C. Welfare Officer, Assistant Social Welfa
x: National Extension Service (1953) came first, then the National Adult Education Programme (2 Oct 1978), then the Adult Education Programme as recast in the 1980s, and the Total Literacy Campaign under the National Literacy Mission (1988): c, b, a, d. 'Adult Education Programme' is loosely worded, so the printed code is kept.

s: Which of the following statements is not true about Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya Yojana?
at: It is funded by State Governments.
src: APPSC Assistant B.C. Welfare Officer, Assistant Social Welfa
x: KGBV (residential upper-primary schools for girls from disadvantaged groups) is a centrally sponsored scheme, now part of Samagra Shiksha with Centre-state sharing, so 'funded by State Governments' is the untrue statement.

s: The 'TRYSEM' programme aims at providing which of the following?
src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I Common Paper General Studies
x: TRYSEM (Training of Rural Youth for Self-Employment, 1979) aimed at self-employment for rural youth.

s:
Navaratnalu seeks to prioritized perspectives on governance. Which of the following would be the reform with a human face?

A. Allot a second house site to those government employees in their area of work

B. Create a friendly environment for the government employees to discharge their duties without any fear, harassment and stress

C. Establish pensioners cell in every district to solve pensioners problems

D. Provide justice to contract employees based on the principle of equal pay for equal work
src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III Village Fisheries Assis
x: Unsettled: an opinion item on the YSRCP manifesto's employee promises; no published key or official document says which of A-D is 'reform with a human face'. A (a second house site) reads as a perk, so B, C and D is the likeliest intended answer, but it cannot be verified.

s: Which of the following is the motto of Real Time Governance in Andhra Pradesh?
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: RTGS works under the motto 'People First' (the People First 1100 call centre collects citizens' feedback).

s: Which of the following cannot be treated as cash
src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer General S
x: Cash covers notes, coins and bank balances (and cash equivalents); long-term investments are not cash.

s: Which of the following is an example of fixed cost for a farm?
src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
x: Fixed costs do not vary with output – land rent, depreciation, interest on fixed capital; seeds, fertiliser and labour are variable costs.

s: Which of the following is true in relation to the first five year plan of India for the period April 1951 to March, 1956?
at: The planning commission presented a draft outline of a plan of development in July, 1951
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: The Planning Commission published the Draft Outline of the First Plan in July 1951; the final plan came in December 1952.

s: Which of the following was an essential element of strategy, in Fourth Five Year Plan of India, aimed at achieving balance on foreign account and goal of self reliance?
at: A sustained increase of exports by about 7 percent a year during the plan period
src: APPSC Deputy Executive Information Engineers & Inspector of
x: The Fourth Plan sought balance on foreign account and self-reliance through a sustained rise of exports by about 7 per cent a year.

s: According to twelfth five year plan document, development of which of the following is a general capability enhancer for all agents?
src: APPSC Deputy Executive Information Engineers & Inspector of
x: The Twelfth Plan calls infrastructure 'a general capability enhancer for all agents', alongside human and institutional capabilities.

s: The average rate of growth of industrial production during the 11th Plan against the target of 10.00 percent per annum was
src: APPSC Group-II Mains 2019 Paper-3
x: APPSC dropped this question. Industry was targeted at about 10% a year in the Eleventh Plan, but sources give different achieved figures (manufacturing about 7.7% to 2009-10, industry 7.2-7.4%), so no single option can be keyed.

s: For the Tenth Five Year Plan period, states have been grouped into A, B, C and D for financing of States' plan investments. In which group is the state of Andhra Pradesh included?
src: APPSC Group-I 2004
x: The Tenth Plan grouped States by per capita GSDP: A high income, B middle income (Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan), C low income, D special category.

s: First Five Year Plan was launched on
src: APPSC AP Town Planning and Building Overseers 2012
x: The First Five Year Plan was launched on 1 April 1951 with priority to agriculture and irrigation; 1952 and 1953 are wrong, and 1-3-1961 is near the Third Plan's start.

s: As per Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) India Index-Baseline Report-2018, for the construction of SDG India index, NITI Aayog left out which one of the following SDG?
src: APPSC Deputy Executive Information Engineers & Inspector of
x: The 2018 baseline SDG India Index scored only 13 goals; it left out SDG 12 (sustainable consumption and production), 13 and 14 for lack of State data, and SDG 17.

s: The Andhra Pradesh State has adopted which of the following approach to achieve the Human Development Index of 0.9 by 2029 and to provide basic services to its people?
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: AP's Vision aimed at an HDI of 0.9 by 2029 and basic services for all through the saturation approach (every eligible household covered).

s: Period of Eleventh Five Year Plan
src: APPSC Medical Officers (Unani) 2013
x: The 11th Plan ran from 1 April 2007 to 31 March 2012.

s:
Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion in collaboration with the World Bank ranked Indian States in 2018 in 'ease of doing business' ranking. Which of the following sequences is correct in descending order of ranking:

a. Haryana

b. Gujarat

c. Andhra Pradesh

d. Telangana

e. Jharkhand
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: DIPP 2018 ranking: Andhra Pradesh 1, Telangana 2, Haryana 3, Jharkhand 4, Gujarat 5 – c-d-a-e-b.

s:
Read the following statements:

a. World Press Freedom Day (WPFD) is celebrated all over the world on the 3rd of May.

b. The theme for WPFD 2019 is 'Media for Democracy: Journalism and Elections in Times of Disinformation'.

c. World Press Freedom Day was proclaimed by the UN General Assembly in December 1991.

d. India ranked 130th in 2019 World Press Freedom Index.
Which of the above statements is/are incorrect?
src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer Screening Test General Stu
x: c is wrong – the UNGA proclaimed World Press Freedom Day in December 1993; d is wrong – India was 140th in WPFI 2019. a (3 May) and b (2019 theme) are correct.

s: What does GNP stand for?
src: SSC CGL 2019
x: GNP stands for Gross National Product (options c and d are printed identically).

s: Which of the following method of measuring GNP is called as Final Product Method?
src: APPSC Deputy Executive Information Engineers & Inspector of
x:
Most books (NIOS, NCERT-based notes, NextGen): final product method = product method. The APPSC flashcard key gave "Expenditure method".
The final product method values the final goods and services produced and is a variant of the product (output) method, the other being the value added method; the expenditure method is the final expenditure (outlay) method.

s: In which of the following sampling method, the population is categorized into different classes and a sample is drawn from these classes?
src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer General S
x: In stratified sampling the population is divided into strata (classes) and a sample is drawn from each.

s: The whole group from which the units of sample are selected is called:
src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
x: The whole group from which sample units are drawn is the population, also called the universe.

s: In the ____ sampling, each subject or unit in the population has an equal chance of being selected.
src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer Screening Test General Stu
x: In simple random sampling every unit of the population has an equal chance of selection.

s: Which of the following is the program with the objective of reducing maternal and neonatal mortality rate among poor pregnant women?
src: APPSC Assistant B.C. Welfare Officer, Assistant Social Welfa
x: Janani Suraksha Yojana aims to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality among poor pregnant women by promoting institutional delivery.

s: Which of the following is not a duty of ASHA-Sahyogini under Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)?
at: To provide immunization to pregnant mothers
src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
x: Under JSY the ASHA identifies and registers pregnant women, arranges check-ups and escorts them for delivery; giving immunisation herself is not her duty (ANMs immunise).

s: Which of the following is true in relation to rural poverty, in India in 2011-12, based on Head Count Ratio Method?
at: The rural poverty in India was around 25.7%
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: By the Tendulkar method, rural poverty in 2011-12 was about 25.7% (urban 13.7%, all-India 21.9%).

s: The poverty rate in India is
src: APPSC Group-II 2008
x: No option fits a datable official figure: before December 2009 the official 2004-05 estimate was 27.5% (URP), later revised to 37.2% (Tendulkar); 32, 35 and 40 match no official series. The undated stem cannot be keyed.

s: The poverty rate in India is
src: APPSC Group-II (old paper)
x: Same question: the official figures are 27.5% (2004-05 URP), 37.2% (2004-05 Tendulkar), 29.8% (2009-10) and 21.9% (2011-12); without a year the options cannot be keyed.

s: Which of the following is true in relation to rate of unemployment in the Indian economy?
at: The rate of unemployment declined from 8.2 per cent in 2004-05 to 6.6 per cent in 2009-10
src: APPSC Assistant Director of Economics, Assistant Commissione
x: The rate of unemployment (CDS) fell from 8.2% in 2004-05 to 6.6% in 2009-10, reversing the earlier rise from 6.1% in 1993-94.

s:
Select the option defining the arrangement of the following R&D schemes of the GOI in their chronological order i.e. starting with earliest scheme and moving on to the next scheme:

A. Integrated Rural Development Programme (IRDP)

B. Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)

C. National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM)

D. DeenDayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I

s: Which of the following Government scheme aims at providing guaranteed employment to the poor?
at: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M
x: MGNREGA guarantees 100 days of wage employment a year to every rural household that asks for unskilled manual work.

s: SGSY is a restructured version of which of the following large-scale programs
src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
x: SGSY restructured IRDP and TRYSEM together with DWCRA, SITRA, GKY and the Million Wells Scheme.

s: Which of the following may not be a strategic tool of development communication in Rural Areas?
src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
x: Development communication in rural areas uses folk media, radio, community video, interpersonal and participatory channels; business-to-business (B2B) media serve commerce, not rural development.

s: Which of the following is the nodal institute for all State Institutes of Rural Development?
at: National Institute of Rural Development & Panchayati Raj
src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
x: NIRDPR, Hyderabad (Ministry of Rural Development) is the apex training institute and the nodal body for all State Institutes of Rural Development.

s: Which of the following is a major technique of PRA?
src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
x: Village (social/resource) mapping is a major Participatory Rural Appraisal tool, along with transect walks, seasonal calendars and wealth ranking.

s: What is the distance to be maintained in between the cattle shed and the main building of residential premises and the distance between the water sources and the community toilets in the village respectively?
src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Screening Test GS-MA 201
x: Rural sanitation siting norms. No checked source gives both distances (printed key 10 m and 250 m), so the question is left unkeyed; the owner should check the AP Panchayat Raj sanitation manual.

s:
Which of the following statement is incorrect about Kakinada-

a. It is the second most populated city of East Godavari district.

b. The Indian Standard Time (IST) passes through this city.

c. The city was selected as one of the hundred Indian cities to be developed as a smart city under PM Narendra Modi's flagship, Smart Cities Mission.
src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
x: All three statements about Kakinada are commonly accepted: second most populous city of East Godavari, on the IST meridian (82.5°E) line, and a Smart City – so none is incorrect.

s: According to hierarchy needs theory, which one of the following needs is the highest in the hierarchy?
src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
x: In Maslow's hierarchy, self-actualisation is the highest need, above esteem, belonging, safety and physiological needs.

s: "A school is a sacred place where all are learning about the complexity of life and its simplicity". Whose statement is this?
src: APPSC Assistant B.C. Welfare Officer, Assistant Social Welfa
x: The idea of the school as a sacred place where all learn about the complexity and simplicity of life comes from J. Krishnamurti's writings on education.

s: Which of the following is not an obstacle to educational change?
src: APPSC Assistant B.C. Welfare Officer, Assistant Social Welfa
x: Answer cannot be settled: the options of this item are lost, and cultural lag is usually listed as an obstacle to educational change, not a non-obstacle, so the printed answer 'Cultural lag' looks wrong.

s: The concept of mobile schools was put forth by?
src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
x: Not settled: no source in the library or on the web credits the 'mobile schools' concept to any of the four names, so the printed key (McDonald) stays unverified.

s: Read the following statements carefully and choose the wrong one:
at: The 1986 National Educational Policy was reviewed by Yashpal Committee.
src: APPSC Assistant B.C. Welfare Officer, Assistant Social Welfa
x: The wrong statement: NPE 1986 was reviewed by the Acharya Ramamurti Committee (1990) and the Janardhana Reddy Committee (1992); the Yash Pal Committee (1993) dealt with 'Learning without Burden'.

s: Which of the following examinations does the National Institute of Open Schooling conduct?
src: APPSC Assistant B.C. Welfare Officer, Assistant Social Welfa
x: NIOS conducts Secondary and Senior Secondary examinations through open schooling.

s: Which of the following is a non-projected aid?
src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
x: Non-projected teaching aids are used without a projector – charts, pictures, graphs, models and pictographs; slides and films are projected aids.

s: The average cultivable land in Andhra Pradesh
src: APPSC Assistant Conservator of Forests 2012
x: The question does not say which year or measure; AP's average holding was 1.08 ha (undivided, 2010-11), 1.06 ha (residual, 2010-11) and 0.94 ha (2015-16). 1.10 is the nearest but no option can be confirmed, so it stays without a key.

s: Which of the following was introduced by the government of India, for providing fertiliser subsidy on Pilot basis, from October-2016?
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: DBT in fertilisers began on a pilot basis in October 2016; the subsidy goes to companies after sale through PoS devices.

s: What was the achievement (in nearest lakhs) during 2016-17 by Andhra Pradesh in distribution of Soil Health Cards of farmers?
src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I 2017
x: AP's 2016-17 Soil Health Card figure could not be found: a July 2016 Rajya Sabha answer (seen only as a search snippet) gives about 22.24 lakh cards cumulative by mid-2016, which fits none of the options safely, so the key is left open.

s: What is the position of India in sugarcane production in the World?
src: Assistant Architectural Surveyor & Deputy Surveyor 2017
x: India is the world's second-largest sugarcane producer, after Brazil.

s: Which one of the following is the pathway to increase productivity in agriculture?
src: U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2007 +1 more
x: Efficient irrigation, quality seeds, pesticides and fertilisers all raise farm productivity, so the stem as printed has no single answer (the UPPSC key gives pesticides, and its explanation is about causes of low productivity). Left unkeyed.

s: The target growth rate of agricultural sector as per National Agricultural Policy, 2000 was in excess of
src: APPSC Group-II Prelims 2017 (26-02-2017)
x: NAP 2000 set a growth target in excess of 4% per annum for agriculture.

s: In the union budget 2018-19, central government proposed to launch which one of the following programme?
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: Budget 2018-19 announced Operation Greens on the lines of Operation Flood for tomato, onion and potato.

s:
The term undernutrition comprises which of the following:
i. Protein energy malnutrition
ii. Micronutrient deficiency
iii. Stunting
iv. Overweight
v. Wasting
vi. Obesity
Tick mark the correct option.
src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
x: Undernutrition comprises protein-energy malnutrition, micronutrient deficiency, stunting and wasting; overweight and obesity are overnutrition.

s:
Consider the following statements with respect to 'Gram Samridhi Yojana'.

a. Gram Samridhi Yojana, is a Rs. 3,000 crore scheme funded by the World Bank and the Government of India, to strengthen the unorganised food processing sector concentrated in rural areas.

b. World Bank will be giving Rs. 1,000 crore, Rs. 1,500 crore will be borne by the Centre while state governments will put in Rs. 500 crore.

c. The scheme will be run in Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Punjab for a 5-year period.
Which of the above statement is incorrect?
src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M
x: Statement b is the incorrect one: of the Rs 3,000 crore, the World Bank gives Rs 1,500 crore, the Centre Rs 1,000 crore and the States Rs 500 crore (not WB 1,000 / Centre 1,500). Statements a and c (UP, AP, Maharashtra, Punjab; 5 years) are correct.

s: According to the latest official statistics for 2024 - 25 , what is the growth rate achieved in fishing and aquaculture in India ?
src: APPSC 2025 Agriculture Officer In A.P. Agriculture Service
x: No option can be confirmed: the official 2024-25 national accounts do not give a fishing growth figure matching 5.3/10.2/15.6/20.1 that could be found (fish output grew about 7.5%; AP's fishing GVA grew 11.29% at constant prices). Left unkeyed.

s: Economic Survey 2011-12 of Govt. of India has highlighted that the country's engineering industry accounts for ..... of India's GDP.
src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers 2012
x: The Economic Survey 2011-12 put the engineering sector, the largest segment of Indian industry, at about 3% of GDP; no source supports 4, 4½ or 2.

s: SEZ units eligible for a corporate tax holiday upto
src: APPSC AEEs 2011
x: The stem is garbled: SEZ units get a 15-year Section 10AA deduction (100%-50%-50%) for units operational by 30 June 2020, while old 10A/10B holidays for EOU/STPI units ended in 2010-11; no single printed year is the SEZ holiday's end, so no key is given.

s: Which of the following is true if the exchange rate between the Dollar and Rupee moved from $1 = Rs 60 to $1 = Rs 70?
src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer Screening Test General Stu
x: From $1 = ₹60 to $1 = ₹70, more rupees are needed for a dollar, so the rupee depreciated and the dollar appreciated.

s: After India joined the WTO as a member, the aspect of the country's economy which was greatly benefitted was
src: APPSC AEEs 2011
x: No verifiable answer: the question asks which sector 'greatly benefitted' from WTO membership, a matter of opinion. Manufactured exports (textile quotas ended 2005) and forex reserves both grew after 1995, and no source credits one option; left unkeyed.

s: In relation WTO, which of the following contains Peace Clause?
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: The Peace Clause belongs to the WTO Agreement on Agriculture (Art. 13, renewed for public stockholding at Bali 2013).

s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

1. 10 rupee note - 63 mm X 123 mm, Chocolate Brown, Sun Temple

2. 50 rupee note - 66 mm X 135 mm, Fluorescent blue, Hampi with Chariot

3. 100 rupee note - 66 mm X 142 mm, Lavender, Rani Ki Vav
src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer Screening Test General Stu
x: All three pairs match: ₹10 is 123×63 mm, chocolate brown, Konark Sun Temple; ₹50 is 135×66 mm, fluorescent blue, Hampi with chariot; ₹100 is 142×66 mm, lavender, Rani ki Vav.

s:
Consider the following statements regarding the role of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI):

a. The RBI manages the public debt on behalf of the Central and State governments in India.

b. The RBI acts as a banker to various State governments in India.
Which of the statements given above is/are incorrect?
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
x: Both statements are correct: the RBI manages the public debt of the Centre and the States and is banker to the State Governments (Sec 21/21A), so neither is incorrect.

src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer Screening Test General Stu
x: PNB - 'The name you can BANK upon'; Union Bank - 'Good people to bank with'; Andhra Bank - 'Where India Banks'; Bank of India - 'Relationship beyond banking'.

s: Which of the following is the adjudicating Authority for insolvency resolution process of banks and corporate houses?
src: APPSC Assistant Director of Economics, Assistant Commissione
x: The NCLT is the adjudicating authority for corporate insolvency under the IBC; the DRT handles individuals and partnership firms.

s: Which of the following is the world's largest financial inclusion programs launched in India?
src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
x: PMJDY is the world's largest financial inclusion programme (Guinness record for accounts opened in a week).

s: India launched the world's first interoperable quick response code for the following except one. Identify the wrong reason.
at: We do not even need to have a bank account
src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
x: Bharat QR (Feb 2017), the world's first interoperable QR code acceptance solution, still debits the payer's bank account – 'no bank account needed' is the wrong reason.

s: Which of the following is a capital market instrument in India?
src: APPSC Deputy Executive Information Engineers & Inspector of
x: Equities (shares) are capital market instruments; T-bills and CPs belong to the money market.

s:
Consider the following taxes:

1. Income Tax

2. Corporate Tax

3. Service Tax

4. Custom Duties
Which of the above is/are Direct Taxes?
src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
x: Income tax and corporate tax are direct taxes; service tax and customs duty are indirect.

s: On which one of the following items the GST council, in its 31st meeting, reduced the GST rate from 12% to nil?
src: APPSC Assistant Director of Economics, Assistant Commissione
x: The 31st GST Council meeting (22 December 2018) cut the rate on music books from 12% to nil.

s: What is the uniform GST rate that has been fixed up for lottery prizes by the GST Council?
src: SSC CGL 2019
x:
Updated to the latest (Nov 2026): Lottery is taxed at 40% from 22 Sep 2025 (56th GST Council, 3 Sep 2025), up from 28%. (When this paper was set, the answer was: 28%.) Review the present arrangements on Financing

s: The net borrowing of the States for the year 2021-22 was fixed at what percentage of the Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) of the States?
